results.title: Midterm mindset seeping into the U.S. stock market

results.content:
The Democrats’ lead over Republicans in an average of national polls on the generic congressional ballot stands at 6.4 points, the same as on August 3. The high point so far for Democrats in 2026 was a lead of 7.1 points.  

August brought Republicans some good news as gas prices leveled out. The average price for a gallon of gas today stands at $4.09, which is down a penny from last month and is substantially lower than the peak average of roughly $4.50 a gallon earlier this year.
